vibe_rationale: Community-trusted, curated and free, with a guest curator and a pan-Latin American publishing network, though single-scene and municipally hosted.
fit_notes: Creative, adult, design-literate publishers and art-book readers, with weak wellness adjacency. One long-running partner (Casa Rex) and a municipal backer, with no partnership contact published. Brand presence would need to be cultural, such as a commissioned zine. The latest visitor figure is from 2023, so it is dated.
